skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to effectively and dynamically describe large datasets through visualization techniques.
Students will be proficient in applying modern data analysis methods to both qualitative and quantitative data.
Students will master techniques for reducing data dimensions, including Principal Component Analysis, Correspondence Analysis, and Multiple Correspondence Analysis.
Students will develop the ability to make evidence-based decisions from data analysis in economic, management, and business contexts.
Students will understand the social context and ethical considerations in data analysis.
Students will learn to work independently and collaboratively to solve problems.
Students will be able to organize and execute data analysis models in real-world scenarios.
Students will be adept at using statistical software for data analysis.
Students will develop the ability to conduct independent research and self-study.
Students will enhance their problem-solving skills through practical data analysis tasks.

prerequisite_courses: Thống kê trong kinh tế và kinh doanh
